ui.f.title: GTA Online FAQ
ui.f.intro: The questions players ask most, answered in our own words. Every answer says how sure we are and where the information comes from.
ui.f.srcThread: This page is built around the community question thread on r/gtaonline:
ui.f.srcNote: Cards labelled Community FAQ, Player tip or Community opinion are original summaries of that thread's FAQ and selected replies, prepared on 9 November 2026 by a researcher who could open the thread – we could not open Reddit ourselves. They are not copies of the comments and not official Rockstar advice. The other cards are written from the Rockstar pages and public guides linked under each question.
ui.f.confHelp: Verified = Rockstar's own page says so. Consensus = most guides agree. Community FAQ = the thread's own FAQ, written by the community, not by Rockstar. Player tip = one player's answer, not checked. Opinion = personal advice or taste. Unconfirmed = only one source or we could not check it.
ui.i.start.q: I'm new and broke – how do I start making money?
ui.i.start.insight: The most repeated beginner advice: start with free or cheap solo jobs, then put your first big money into something that earns, not into cars.
ui.i.start.explain: Contact missions such as Gerald's jobs or Simeon's repo missions cost nothing to start and pay steadily. Newer free activities like the Cluckin' Bell Farm Raid are quoted at several hundred thousand GTA$ per run, and the host's first run each week pays more because of the weekly first-completion bonus. Exact amounts differ from guide to guide.
ui.i.start.rec: Grind free missions first, save for one money-making property, and leave supercars and cosmetics for later.
ui.i.firstbiz.insight: The Acid Lab is the most common first-purchase pick in 2026 guides; the Nightclub is the most praised passive earner.
ui.i.firstbiz.explain: The Acid Lab is unlocked through the First Dose missions, and guides put its upgrade at about GTA$750k. One guide estimates roughly GTA$120k every 48 minutes when you supply it yourself. A Nightclub gathers goods from your other businesses by itself, so it gets better the more businesses you own. One guide ranks the Cocaine Lockup best per hour among passive businesses. All of these are guide estimates, not Rockstar figures.
ui.i.firstbiz.rec: Pick one earner you will really run (the Acid Lab is a cheap start), learn its loop, then expand.
ui.i.nightclub.q: Is the Nightclub worth it, and how does it make money?
ui.i.nightclub.insight: Players agree it is a strong passive earner, but they disagree on how much the safe pays.
ui.i.nightclub.explain: It has two incomes. The safe fills by itself depending on popularity – guides quote anything from about GTA$10k to about GTA$50k per in-game day, so that number is disputed. The bigger money is the warehouse: technicians collect goods from businesses you own. The first technician is free and more cost extra (one guide lists GTA$141k for the second). Tony takes a cut of technician-sourced sales.
ui.i.nightclub.rec: Buy it once you own a few other businesses, don't worry much about popularity unless you are idle, and sell warehouse stock when the load is worth the trip.
ui.i.cayo.q: Is the Cayo Perico Heist still the best solo money?
ui.i.cayo.insight: It is still the most-cited solo heist, but some 2026 guides now rank other solo activities higher.
ui.i.cayo.explain: Guides estimate about GTA$1M or more per run with a good setup. Title Update 1.73 (July 2026) lowered base payouts and added a weekly first-completion bonus, so your first run of the week pays the most. One guide calls a different activity (The Data Leaks) the best solo method overall – opinions differ.
ui.i.cayo.rec: Do your first Cayo run of the week right after the Thursday reset, and plan loot and cuts with the heist planner on this site.
ui.i.weekly.q: Why did my heist pay less than a video said?
ui.i.weekly.insight: Many players noticed lower repeat payouts after the July 2026 update, and older videos show the old numbers.
ui.i.weekly.explain: Since Title Update 1.73 (14 July 2026), base payouts for many heists and missions are lower, and the first completion of each listed finale per week pays an extra bonus to the host and the crew. Rockstar has not published the exact size of that bonus. Event weeks change it again: for 5–11 November 2026 Rockstar doubled the first-completion bonuses for the Original Heists, the Doomsday Heist and the Diamond Casino Heist. Other sites also report a guaranteed Panther Statue that week, which we could not confirm on Rockstar's own page.
ui.i.weekly.rec: Make your best heist the first run of the week, and check the Rockstar Newswire every Thursday for event bonuses.
ui.i.private.q: Can I run and sell my businesses in an Invite Only session?
ui.i.private.insight: Yes. It is one of the most asked questions – and many old guides still wrongly say no.
ui.i.private.explain: Since The Criminal Enterprises update (26 July 2022) you can register as a CEO, VIP or MC President and do business work, including sell missions, in Invite Only, Crew and Friend sessions. The trade-off: selling in a public session pays an extra high-demand bonus that private sessions don't.
ui.i.private.rec: Sell in Invite Only when griefers are a problem; sell in public only if you want the bonus and the lobby is quiet.
ui.i.passive.q: Does Passive Mode keep me safe?
ui.i.passive.insight: Only partly. It stops players shooting you, but players say it is not full protection.
ui.i.passive.explain: In Passive Mode other players can't target you with weapons, but guides note that you can still be run over. One guide also says you can't do business work while it is on – check this in your own game.
ui.i.passive.rec: For real peace, play in an Invite Only session; use Passive Mode as a short shield when you just need to travel.
ui.i.solopublic.q: Can I get a public session with nobody else in it?
ui.i.solopublic.insight: Players share workarounds that briefly cut the connection so they end up alone in a public lobby.
ui.i.solopublic.explain: This is not an official option, and guides note that new players can still be matched into your lobby later. Since Invite Only sessions now allow selling, most reasons for the trick are gone.
ui.i.solopublic.rec: Use an Invite Only session instead – we don't recommend network tricks.
ui.i.migrate.q: Can I move my character to another platform or to GTA V Enhanced on PC?
ui.i.migrate.insight: Players often ask before buying a new version. PC Legacy → PC Enhanced is a one-time move; PC ↔ console isn't supported.
ui.i.migrate.explain: Rockstar's support page says an Online profile can be migrated from GTAV Legacy to GTAV Enhanced on PC only once, and it can't be undone. Your Legacy progress stays, but afterwards Legacy and Enhanced progress are separate. Moving between PC and consoles isn't supported. One guide warns that migrating overwrites any Online progress you already have on Enhanced, and suggests waiting and trying again later if you see 'not eligible for migration'.
ui.i.migrate.rec: Decide which character you want before you migrate, and avoid building up a new Enhanced character you'd hate to lose.
ui.f.archived: {n} answers about past weekly events or disputed topics are kept out of this page so they aren't mistaken for current rules.
ui.f.vol.event: Depends on the event or promotion
ui.f.vol.platform: Platform rules – check Rockstar's latest info
ui.i.r001.q: Which activities are good for making money?
ui.i.r001.a: It depends on how you like to play: hands-on jobs such as Cayo Perico, the Dr. Dre Contract, the Cluckin Bell Raid and KnoWay Sabotage; produce-and-sell businesses such as the Acid Lab and the Bunker; and income you manage now and then, such as the Nightclub. Check the weekly bonuses before you choose, because what pays best changes from week to week.
ui.i.r003.q: I finished a challenge but the reward never arrived – what should I do?
ui.i.r003.a: First check the event's conditions and note when you completed it. The community FAQ says some rewards can take up to 72 hours. If the announced waiting time has passed and it still hasn't arrived, contact Rockstar Support with your proof.
ui.i.r007.q: Do the businesses linked to my Nightclub need to be kept supplied?
ui.i.r007.a: According to the community FAQ, the source businesses for the Nightclub warehouse only need to be set up and running. You don't have to do their supply and sell loops for the Nightclub warehouse to work.
ui.i.r008.q: Why does the Prize Ride Challenge count days differently from when I played?
ui.i.r008.a: The challenge days mentioned in the FAQ follow UTC, not your local time. Check the event's cut-off time before you plan to play several days in a row.
ui.i.r011.q: A car I bought is missing from my garage – where should I look?
ui.i.r011.a: Check the personal vehicle menu, call Mors Mutual Insurance, look at the impound lot, and check every property and garage – including storage in service vehicles. Only if you still can't find it, open a Rockstar Support ticket.
ui.i.r014.q: If I move my Nightclub to another location, what doesn't come with it?
ui.i.r014.a: A community answer warns that moving may mean buying the upgrades again, and unsold stock does not move with you. Deal with your stock before you decide to move.
ui.i.r019.q: I have a lump of cash – buy a Mansion or a money-making business first?
ui.i.r019.a: If your goal is more income, the person answering recommends investing in something that earns first, then buying fun properties such as a Mansion later. Players who play mainly for fun may choose differently.
ui.i.r019.note: Gameplay advice, not a guaranteed return.
ui.i.r022.q: How can I sell Bunker stock solo without the hassle?
ui.i.r022.a: A tip from the thread: buy supplies for one round at a time and sell what that round produced, so each delivery stays small. Good if you want less hassle playing alone; check the sell vehicles and amounts in your version.
ui.i.r024.q: Does the Acid Lab keep producing while I'm offline?
ui.i.r024.a: A reply in the thread confirms that production stops when you leave the game, so time spent in-game matters when you plan production and resupplying.
ui.i.r025.q: Should I sell the Acid Lab when it's full, or let stock sit?
ui.i.r025.a: The community tip is not to leave it full for long, because production stops. If you play for income, plan resupply and selling so production isn't idle longer than needed.
ui.i.r027.q: How do I choose between the Raiju, the Kosatka Sparrow and the Toreador?
ui.i.r027.a: The Raiju suits long air trips and stealth; the Sparrow is about agility for travel and general jobs; the Toreador stands out on roads and underwater. Also check where each one can be called in during different missions.
ui.i.r031.q: As a new player, should I do every mission on the map in order?
ui.i.r031.a: The community idea is to try many kinds of missions at least once, then repeat the ones you enjoy or that fit your goal. You don't have to play only for maximum money.
ui.i.r033.q: I want to start heists but I'm afraid of wasting the team's time – how do I prepare?
ui.i.r033.a: Players suggest watching a short guide or video so you know the steps and where teams usually fail, then trying more forgiving jobs before missions that need strict teamwork.
ui.i.r044.q: Is the payout alone enough to choose a heist?
ui.i.r044.a: Players suggest also weighing how many people it needs, your skill, prep time and the chance of failing. A high payout isn't the best deal if one run takes a long time or you keep waiting for a team.
ui.i.r044.note: The thread has no verified earnings-per-hour formula.
ui.i.r004.q: A game mode I used to play is gone from the menu – what happened?
ui.i.r004.a: Some modes rotate in and out with the weekly events and bonuses. Check the current event list before you decide a mode was removed for good.
ui.i.r006.q: I found a strange modded car parked by the road – what is it?
ui.i.r006.a: It may be linked to Exotic Exports or come from another job or event. Finding a car doesn't always mean you can export it or get a reward – check whether it matches the relevant list.
ui.i.r009.q: I renewed GTA+ but the benefits haven't shown up – why?
ui.i.r009.a: Benefits can appear late around a renewal or a package update. Check your membership status and the benefit period; if it stays wrong, contact support.
ui.i.r010.q: How can I know when an old bonus or discount will come back?
ui.i.r010.a: No schedule guarantees that a promotion will return. Follow Rockstar's weekly event announcements instead of guessing dates from earlier rounds.
ui.i.r012.q: The stats on Rockstar's website don't match the game – which is right?
ui.i.r012.a: The web profile can update later than the game, so trust what the game shows. Ask Support to check if it affects your rewards or property.
ui.i.r013.q: Why does my heist keep rolling the same target or random reward?
ui.i.r013.a: Random rolls can give the same result several times in a row. A repeat alone doesn't prove the game is broken; keep it apart from drop rates and special rules that can change with updates.
ui.i.r015.q: Does a more expensive Nightclub location produce more than a cheap one?
ui.i.r015.a: In this conversation the person answering thought the price difference is about the location, not extra production. Choose by how easy it is to travel and sell, not by price alone.
ui.i.r015.note: A short answer from one person – don't stretch it to mean there are no other differences.
ui.i.r016.q: In Cayo Perico, with loot at both the airstrip and the compound – where should I start?
ui.i.r016.a: A reply in the thread suggests grabbing the airstrip loot before you go into the compound when your route covers both, because staying undetected can get harder once you have the primary target. The best route still depends on your team size and what spawned that run.
ui.i.r017.q: Does the High Roller disguise in the Casino Heist need the usual disguise prep?
ui.i.r017.a: A community answer says that once the High Roller outfit is unlocked you can use it as your disguise without doing the normal disguise prep mission. Check the unlock condition again in the current game version.
ui.i.r018.q: How long does the Dr. Dre Contract take solo?
ui.i.r018.a: It depends on skill, travel and loading times. A player in the thread suggested that once you know it well you can get close to about an hour, but no fixed time can be promised.
ui.i.r018.note: A player's estimate, not a statistical average.
ui.i.r020.q: I already own the Route 68 Bunker – do I need to move it right away?
ui.i.r020.a: The person answering thought Route 68 is a workable location. If your delivery routes are fine and money is tight, keep using it rather than paying to move just for a new location.
ui.i.r021.q: Which Bunker locations do players recommend most?
ui.i.r021.a: Some players suggest Farmhouse and Chumash as convenient, but the choice still depends on how you sell and what you usually do. Compare the actual prices before you decide.
ui.i.r023.q: New player: start with the Acid Lab or buy a Facility first?
ui.i.r023.a: In a tight-budget example comparing the Acid Lab with a Paleto Bay Facility, the person answering picked the Acid Lab first – in line with buying an earning business before heist properties.
ui.i.r026.q: Do I have to rename my Acid Lab product every time to get the bonus?
ui.i.r026.a: According to the reply in the thread, naming the product for the bonus is a one-time thing; you don't need to rename it before each sale. Still check the current bonus conditions in the game.
ui.i.r026.note: Bonuses and rates can change with updates.
ui.i.r028.q: Any tips for landing the Oppressor Mk I more accurately?
ui.i.r028.a: The person answering recommends practising your distance judgement and planning the touchdown spot in advance: it can fly, but landing still needs more space and control than the Mk II.
ui.i.r029.q: Players disappeared from my public session during a sale – did I disconnect?
ui.i.r029.a: The reply separates two cases: if most players vanish at once it may be your connection, but if they leave one by one and nobody joins, it may just be normal player movement. Use it as a first check, not a sure network diagnosis.
ui.i.r030.q: Is there a website that compares car performance in GTA Online?
ui.i.r030.a: The gtacars.net vehicle database was suggested for a question about short-distance acceleration. Read how its stats are defined and tested before you buy.
ui.i.r032.q: Are the Daily/Weekly Challenges worth it for new players?
ui.i.r032.a: It depends on your goal – money, RP, awards or just variety. If a challenge doesn't match your goal, you don't need to force yourself to finish them all.
ui.i.r034.q: How do I raise Strength and survive better in GTA Online?
ui.i.r034.a: Strength goes up through play and some kinds of activity, but players in the thread stress that using cover, keeping your distance and picking good fighting positions help you survive right away, without waiting for stats.
ui.i.r035.q: Where do I find a team for heists or group activities?
ui.i.r035.a: The thread recommends the r/HeistTeams community for finding a team or people to play with. Read each group's rules and say clearly which platform you're on, when you play and what you need.
ui.i.r035.note: Taken from the list of recommended communities at the top of the post.
ui.i.r037.q: When do GTA Online's weekly events usually change?
ui.i.r037.a: The introduction of the thread gives Thursday 10:00 UTC as the reference time for weekly event news. Some events and game updates have their own times, so confirm with the latest announcement.
ui.i.r038.q: Is the Nightclub still worth it if I don't own many MC businesses?
ui.i.r038.a: A player in the thread thinks the Nightclub pays off better once the linked source businesses are set up. If you don't have them yet, weigh the total start-up cost before buying.
ui.i.r043.q: Not sure when my GTA+ expires – where should I check?
ui.i.r043.a: Check the renewal date and time in the subscription details on the platform you pay through; the times in marketing announcements aren't necessarily your account's billing cycle.
ui.i.r046.q: If the game freezes at the end of missions again and again, what should I try first?
ui.i.r046.a: One reply recommends clearing the game's cache and testing again. If it keeps happening, note your device, platform and the steps that cause the freeze so you can report it to Support.
ui.i.r046.note: From a reply near the end of the thread; the direct link to that reply wasn't confirmed.
ui.i.r005.q: How do I find out a car's name from a picture?
ui.i.r005.a: Use a picture that clearly shows the front or rear, then ask the community or compare it with a GTA Online vehicle database. Identifying a model from one picture can go wrong when the car has body mods.
ui.i.r036.q: Is the free HSW upgrade voucher only for the La Coureuse?
ui.i.r036.a: A reply in the thread says the voucher is not limited to the La Coureuse. The target car must support the HSW upgrade, and the conditions of the reward still apply.
ui.i.r047.q: Is GTA Online still worth starting now, if I'm also interested in the next GTA?
ui.i.r047.a: A player says GTA Online still offers a lot without needing to own everything. See it as a game where you pick the activities you enjoy, rather than a race against people who started earlier.
ui.i.r047.note: Whether a game is fun is a personal opinion.
ui.i.drdre.q: What is the Dr. Dre Contract and how do I start it?
ui.i.drdre.insight: The thread's FAQ lists it among the best hands-on money jobs. Guides agree on the basics but disagree on the exact unlock step, and payouts changed in 2026.
ui.i.drdre.explain: It is the VIP Contract for owners of an Agency (bought on the Dynasty 8 website; one 2026 guide lists GTA$2,010,000 for the cheapest). Most guides say it appears after you finish one Security Contract from the Agency computer – some say two. It can be played solo. After the July 2026 rebalance, guides quote GTA$900,000 for the leader on the finale, 'Don't Fuck With Dre', and about GTA$1.1M for the first completion after the weekly reset; older guides say GTA$1M. One guide says a replay needs roughly one in-game day of cooldown, and a player in the r/gtaonline thread estimates about an hour per run once you know it.
ui.i.drdre.rec: Worth it if you will also use the Agency's other income. Make the finale your first completion of the week, and check the payout in your game.
ui.i.cluckin.q: What is the Cluckin' Bell Farm Raid?
ui.i.cluckin.insight: Often recommended as a free solo starter job – it is in the thread's FAQ answer on making money.
ui.i.cluckin.explain: A six-mission story job from Vincent Effenburger. Go to Free Roam (public or private), leave any building and wait for his call – no property is needed. It can be done solo or with up to three other players. A recent guide says the host gets GTA$600,000 for the first finale each week and GTA$400,000 for repeats that week; older guides say GTA$500,000.
ui.i.cluckin.rec: A good first big payday for new players. Play the finale right after the Thursday reset to get the first-of-the-week amount.
ui.i.knoway.q: What is KnoWay Out (the KnoWay taxi sabotage missions)?
ui.i.knoway.insight: A newer free mission set that the thread's FAQ lists with the hands-on money jobs.
ui.i.knoway.explain: Five story missions for Avi Schwartzman against a surveillance scheme run through KnoWay's self-driving taxis. You get a text from an unknown number, then answer the payphone at the yellow marker; no property is needed, and the missions are played in order. Payouts differ between guides: a recent one says the finale pays GTA$245,000 on Normal and GTA$367,500 on Hard after the July 2026 cut, with more for the first hosted completion after the weekly reset (GTA$455,700 / GTA$683,550). For 5–11 November 2026 Rockstar doubled the first completion of KnoWay Out.
ui.i.knoway.rec: Play Hard if you can and host the first run of the week; double-check the numbers in your game, because guides disagree.
